note: Only the 5-room 'thicket' maze was fully confirmed to fit a clean fixed 63-byte record. Other rooms in the file likely use a variable-length record (probably record length depends on how many trackable objects/flags that room has), so this fixed stride does not extend further. See ANALYSIS.md for details and next steps.

record_layout_confirmed.byte_0: Pascal length-prefix byte for the room's location phrase (e.g. 'in the thicket')
record_layout_confirmed.byte_40: 0xFF sentinel marking end of the phrase field
record_layout_confirmed.bytes_41_to_62: 22 bytes (~10-11 words) of exit/flag data -- 0x0091 (145) recurs and is hypothesized to be a 'no exit here' sentinel; exact field meaning (which word = which compass direction, etc.) NOT yet confirmed
